Due to problems with gumbo, which caused drilling to stop, and poor hole cleaning hi-vis pills were pumped when required. Back-ground gas levels remained in the region of 40-50 units until around 6700 ft (6681 ft TVD). Balling-up of the bit lead to swabbin

was made at 3390 ft to replace the failed MWD tool. This was found to contain cement from inside the drillpipe; the entire string of drillpipe was laid down for cleaning, and new pipe was picked up. Problems were experienced with gumbo throughout the Hordaland Group. Gumbo rings, bit balling and lost returns occurred from 5321 ft to section TD. The mud weight was progressively raised to ppg by the end of the section,
